message.text:
h11.

Treating `store` (plus its `store/db/*` driver implementations) as "the data layer," and looking at which of its persistent entity types (`store.User`, `store.Memo`, `store.Attachment`, `store.Reaction`, `store.MemoRelation`, `store.MemoShare`, `store.Inbox`, `store.UserIdentity`, `store.InstanceSetting`, `store.IdentityProvider`, `store.UserSetting`) are referenced by type name from packages outside that layer, I counted distinct outside package directories referencing each (`store.<Type>` usages across the repo, excluding `store/` itself and generated proto code):

- `store.User` → 7 packages: `server/auth`, `server/notification`, `server/router/api/v1` (+ its `test` subpackage), `server/router/fileserver`, `server/router/frontend`, `server/router/rss`
- `store.Memo` → 6 packages: `server/notification`, `server/router/api/v1` (+ `test`), `server/router/frontend`, `server/router/rss`, `server/runner/memopayload`
- `store.Attachment` → 4 packages (`server/router/api/v1`, its `test`, `server/router/fileserver`, `server/router/rss`)
- Everything else (`MemoRelation`, `MemoShare`, `Inbox`, `Reaction`, `UserIdentity`, etc.) tops out at 2–3 packages.

**Ranking:**

1st: `User` (`store.User`, defined `store/user.go:29`) — referenced from ~7 packages outside `store/` (`server/auth`, `server/notification`, `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/api/v1/test`, `server/router/fileserver`, `server/router/frontend`, `server/router/rss`)

2nd: `Memo` (`store.Memo`, defined `store/memo.go:35`) — referenced from ~6 packages outside `store/` (`server/notification`, `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/api/v1/test`, `server/router/frontend`, `server/router/rss`, `server/runner/memopayload`)
